# Raka Alpiansyah (rakaalpiansyah) - Software & AI Engineer Portfolio

> Official engineering portfolio of Raka Alpiansyah (handles: rakaalpiansyah, @vcols_), an Informatics Engineering student at Universitas Nasional Pasim and Software & AI Engineer based in Bandung, Indonesia, specializing in backend systems (Laravel, FastAPI, REST APIs), AI/ML engineering (Whisper AI, TensorFlow, Computer Vision), enterprise blockchain (Hyperledger Fabric), and cross-platform Flutter mobile applications.

Raka Alpiansyah builds production backend architectures, AI pipelines, and full-stack web and mobile applications. Official social handles: LinkedIn `in/rakaalpiansyah`, GitHub `@rakaalpiansyah`, and Instagram `@vcols_`.

## Featured Engineering Projects

- [Rehat - Digital Detox & Mindfulness App](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/rehat-app): Cross-platform Flutter & Dart mobile application published on Google Play Store for digital wellbeing and screen-time management.
- [Meeting AI Backend - Whisper Speech Diarization](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/Meeting-AI-Backend): Python 3.11 & FastAPI microservice powered by Whisper AI and PyTorch for automated meeting transcription and speaker diarization.
- [AgriTraceChain - Enterprise Blockchain Supply Chain](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/agritraceChain): 5-organization Hyperledger Fabric permissioned blockchain network with 4 smart contracts and Caliper benchmarking.
- [PlantVillage AI - Leaf Disease Detection CNN](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/plantvillage-disease-detection): 4-block Convolutional Neural Network achieving 97.12% validation accuracy and quantized to TensorFlow Lite (~6ms CPU inference).
- [GreenV - Sustainable Waste Management Platform](https://github.com/rakaalpiansyah/web-GreenV): 1st Place National Web Design winner (Universitas Jambi) built with Laravel for converting verified waste recycling into Eco Points.
